title: Improved Extra Attack
html:
Improved Extra Attack is a Fighter passive feature that allows you to make 2 additional attacks when making an Attack Action.

Description

You can make two additional attacks after attacking with your main-hand weapon.

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 11: Fighter

Used by creatures:

  • Breaker of War, Cazador Szarr, Chadd, Godey, Gravedigger Karcen, Jaryd, Liara Portyr, Malik (iron consul), Marten (iron consul), Mian, Moosk, Nubaldin, Nuff, Qora, Redhammer, Skoona, Stalker Svignee, That Which Guards, Ulder Ravengard, Voss, Yoonce

Notes

  • Despite the description, there is no requirement for the attack to use a weapon. See  Extra Attack for the mechanics of how this ability works.

Brief preview

Can make two more attacks after a main-hand weapon attack.
